QuestInfo.name: [Fight for Azwan] Shamaness Marbles
QuestInfo.0: Medina wants to talk to you now that you've completed a few battles.
QuestInfo.1: Hilla's power is far too great for Medina. She can't save souls faster than they are recaptured. She needs #bShamaness Marbles#k to overcome this difference in power. Visit #bIason#k to see if he can help.
QuestInfo.2: Iason seems to be quite upset.

0.0: Azwan thanks you for your help. I saved a lot of souls, but not as many as I would have liked. Most of them fell back under Hilla's control.
0.1: It's all my fault. My powers cannot match Hilla's magic. #rI just can't fully purify the souls before her power overtakes me#k. I wish I was stronger...
0.2: I can't get any stronger as a ghost, but I might be able to channel my strength through a #bShamaness Marble#k. I think His Majesty may have one. Could you ask him?

yes.0: I'd talk to him myself, but he's not very fond of me...

no.0: You must also be tired from all the fighting. I apologize...

1.0: ...What do you want foreigner? ...A Shamaness Marble?

npc.0: You still haven't seen the king? He's right there...
